summary.headline: Astrological Judgments on Journeys
summary.text: Astrological judgments about journeys: the ascendant, Moon, house lords, angles, ninth house, Mercury, and Mars determine travel, foreign livelihood, success, danger, and changes of region. Chapter XXVIII begins with the utility and damage of a journey.
